question: Is the data in CoVoST annotated for dialect?
title: CoVoST: A Diverse Multilingual Speech-To-Text Translation Corpus
answer_rationale: Text 2 and Text 5 state that CoVoST is diversified with over 60 accents, and Text 6 and Text 8 further confirm that multiple speakers and accents are present, indicating dialect annotation through accent diversity.
